' (truncated at the cap)' : ''}: ${b.decisions} decisions, ${b.outcomes} outcomes`).join('; ')}${r.pending ? `; ${r.pending} hour(s) still to fold` : ''}`);\n            for (const f of r.failed) console.error(`hourly fold ${tenant}: ${f.date} ${String(f.hour).padStart(2, '0')}h failed and is skipped this run: ${f.error}`);\n          })().catch((e) => console.error(`hourly fold ${tenant} failed`, e)));\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      case '0 3 * * *': {\n        // Doc 22 §11: the autonomy cycle, daily. 'ledger'}${r.hours?.missing.length ? ` (${r.hours.missing.length} hour(s) unfolded)` : ''}${r.counts.truncated ? ' (truncated)' : ''}`);\n          })().catch((e) => console.error(`day report ${tenant} ${yesterday} failed`, e)));\n        }\n        // CW28 (doc 22 §15): the erasure rewrite. ', more tomorrow' : ''}`); },\n            (e) => console.error(`erasure rewrite ${tenant} failed`, e),\n          ));\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      case '0 * * * *': {\n        // CW6: sum each tenant's published regions into its countries and into everyone.\n        const tenants = (env.TREND_ROLLUP_TENANTS ?? 'coach').split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);\n        for (const tenant of tenants) {\n          ctx.waitUntil(rollupTenant(env, tenant).then(\n            (r) => console.log(`trend rollup ${tenant}: ${r.regions} regions → ${r.countries.length} countries + everyone`),\n            (e) => console.error(`trend rollup ${tenant} failed`, e),\n          ));\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n      default:\n        console.log('Unknown scheduled event:', event.cron);\n    }\n  },\n  queue: async (batch: MessageBatch, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext) => {\n    // Phase 0 of the outcome-learning design: every ledger message in the batch is\n    // written to R2 in one pass, as range-named objects under the brand and hour.\n    // Only an R2 failure retries; anything the writer cannot place is acknowledged\n    // and counted, so a poison message can never stall the ledger behind it.\n    const ledger = batch.messages.filter((m) => (m.body as { kind?: unknown } | null)?.kind === 'ledger');\n    if (ledger.length) {\n      const res = await consumeLedger(env, ledger.map((m) => m.body));\n      if (res.ok) { for (const m of ledger) m.ack(); }\n      else { console.error(`ledger batch failed: ${res.error}`); for (const m of ledger) m.retry(); }\n      if (res.skipped) console.warn(`ledger: ${res.skipped} unplaceable message(s) acknowledged and dropped`);\n    }\n    for (const message of batch.messages) {\n      if ((message.body as { kind?: unknown } | null)?.kind === 'ledger') continue;\n      try {\n        const event = message.body as any;\n        if (event && event.kind === 'scene') {\n          // Background styled-scene generation → R2 (so the request path never blocks on ~8s gen).\n          const res = await generateSceneToR2(env, event);\n          console.log(`queue scene ${event.productId}/${event.sceneId}: ${res.ok ?       "source": "import { Hono } from 'hono';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\nimport type { Env } from '@/types/env';\nimport { EventSchema, Event } from '@/types/events';\nimport { EventDispatcher } from '@/services/EventDispatcher';\nimport { getUserContext, getPageContext } from '@/utils/context';\n\nconst tracking = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();\n\ntracking.post('/event', async (c) => {\n  try {\n    const body = await c.req.json();\n    const event = EventSchema.parse(body) as Event;\n    \n    const enrichedEvent = {\n      ...event,\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n      source: 'api',\n      user: {\n        ...(event.user || {}),\n        ...getUserContext(c.req),\n        anonymousId: event.user?.anonymousId || crypto.randomUUID(),\n      },\n      page: 'page' in event && event.page ? {\n        ...event.page,\n        ...getPageContext(c.req),\n      } : getPageContext(c.req),\n    };\n\n    const dispatcher = new EventDispatcher(c.env);\n    await dispatcher.dispatch(enrichedEvent);\n\n    await c.env.ANALYTICS.writeDataPoint({\n      blobs: [\n        JSON.stringify(enrichedEvent),\n        enrichedEvent.eventType,\n        enrichedEvent.source,\n      ],\n      doubles: [enrichedEvent.timestamp],\n      indexes: [enrichedEvent.user.userId || enrichedEvent.user.anonymousId || 'unknown'],\n    });\n\n    return c.json({\n      success: true,\n      eventId: enrichedEvent.eventId,\n      timestamp: enrichedEvent.timestamp,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Tracking error:', error);\n    return c.json({ error: 'Invalid event data' }, 400);\n  }\n});\n\ntracking.post('/batch', async (c) => {\n  try {\n    const body = await c.req.json();\n    const BatchSchema = z.object({\n      events: z.array(EventSchema),\n      context: z.object({\n        source: z.string().optional(),\n        campaignId: z.string().optional(),\n        sessionId: z.string().optional(),\n      }).optional(),\n    });\n\n    const { events, context } = BatchSchema.parse(body);\n    const dispatcher = new EventDispatcher(c.env);\n    const results = [];\n\n    for (const event of events) {\n      try {\n        const enrichedEvent = {\n          ...event,\n          timestamp: Date.now(),\n          source: context?.source || 'batch',\n          user: {\n            ...(event.user || {}),\n            ...getUserContext(c.req),\n            anonymousId: event.user?.anonymousId || crypto.randomUUID(),\n          },\n          page: 'page' in event && event.page ? {\n            ...event.page,\n            ...getPageContext(c.req),\n          } : getPageContext(c.req),\n        };\n\n        await dispatcher.dispatch(enrichedEvent);\n\n        await c.env.ANALYTICS.writeDataPoint({\n          blobs: [\n            JSON.stringify(enrichedEvent),\n            enrichedEvent.eventType,\n            enrichedEvent.source,\n          ],\n          doubles: [enrichedEvent.timestamp],\n          indexes: [enrichedEvent.user.userId || enrichedEvent.user.anonymousId || 'unknown'],\n        });\n\n        results.push({\n          eventId: enrichedEvent.eventId,\n          status: 'success',\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Batch event error:', error);\n        results.push({\n          eventId: event.eventId,\n          status: 'error',\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return c.json({\n      success: true,\n      processed: results.length,\n      results,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Batch tracking error:', error);\n    return c.json({ error: 'Invalid batch data' }, 400);\n  }\n});\n\ntracking.get('/health', (c) => {\n  return c.json({ status: 'ok', service: 'tracking' });\n});\n\nexport { tracking as trackingRoutes };"

      "source": "// src/identity/erase.ts\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CW28: the right to be forgotten, end to end.\n//\n// A person is a shopper id and every browser ever linked to it. Erasing them\n// means, in this order: the link table (so no browser resolves to them again),\n// every profile that held their behaviour (the person's session and each\n// browser's, or the shopper objects on the object host), and their rows in the\n// ledger, which the other session's eraseVisitorLedger() handles with a\n// tombstone every reader honours at once and a nightly rewrite of the batches.\n//\n// A visitor id that was never linked is erased on its own: its profile and its\n// ledger rows. A visitor id that was linked erases the whole person, because\n// the browser's behaviour already folded into them and a partial erasure would\n// leave it there.\n//\n// What this does not reach: ODP (Optimizely Data Platform) holds its own copy\n// under the vuid derived from the id; its erasure is ODP's API, run by the\n// brand's operator, and the receipt says so. Analytics Engine holds aggregate\n// points with no identifier worth erasing.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nimport type { Env } from '@/types/env';\nimport type { TenantId } from '@/tenancy/tenant';\nimport { shopperObject } from '@/tenancy/objects';\nimport { SessionManager } from '@/services/SessionManager';\nimport { IdentityStore } from '@/identity/store';\nimport { isShopperId } from '@/identity/shopperId';\nimport { eraseVisitorLedger } from '@/ledger/erasure';\n\nexport interface EraseReceipt {\n  tenant: string;\n  /** What was asked for. */\n  subject: { visitorId?: string; shopperId?: string };\n  /** The person this resolved to, if the subject was linked. */\n  shopperId: string | null;\n  /** Every id whose profile and ledger rows were erased. */\n  erased: string[];\n  profiles: Array<{ id: string; host: 'session' | 'object'; result: 'erased' | 'absent' | 'failed' }>;\n  ledger: Array<{ id: string; tombstone: string | null; ring: string }>;\n  links: { visitors: number; shopper: boolean };\n  /** What this cannot reach, said plainly. */\n  notReached: string[];\n  actor: string;\n  at: number;\n}\n\nasync function eraseProfile(env: Env, tenant: TenantId, id: string, ownSessionId: string | null): Promise<EraseReceipt['profiles'][number]> {\n  if ((env.REFLEX_HOST ?? 'session') === 'do') {\n    try {\n      const res = await shopperObject(env.SHOPPER_REFLEX, id, tenant).fetch('https://shopper-reflex/reset', { method: 'POST' });\n      return { id, host: 'object', result: res.ok ?
